forceWrite.getOidcConfiguration: GET /settings/sso/oidc returns the OIDC sign-in configuration, which carries the identity provider's client settings (n8n.json)
forceWrite.getSamlConfiguration: GET /settings/sso/saml returns the SAML sign-in configuration and certificates (n8n.json)

forceWrite.auth.logout: GET /api/1.0/logout ends the current session and invalidates the access token: a state change behind a GET (time-doctor.json)
forceWrite.auth.logoutById: GET /api/1.0/logout/by-id invalidates a given access token: a state change behind a GET (time-doctor.json)
forceWrite.auth_v2_sso.authV2SsoAuthenticate: GET /api/2.0/auth/v2/sso/{provider}/authenticate starts an SSO sign-in flow, which the agent never does on its own (time-doctor.json)
